The Maynooth Education Campus Parent Teacher Association, (MECPTA) serves as a communication interface between the parents and guardians of the attending pupils and the staff and functions of the schools’. The main purpose of the PTA is to help both Maynooth Post Primary and Maynooth Community College in the provision of the best, safest and healthiest possible learning environment for the attending students.
